subject: Flashcard answer leak: enforce in RLS — shared cards with question_id visible only after the caller has an attempt on that question; never to anon
body: Edit 0001 in place: flashcards select policy for shared cards (owner_user_id is null): if question_id is null → visible to authenticated (and anon only if that's already the rule for non-question cards); if question_id is not null → visible only to authenticated callers with exists (select 1 from public.attempts a where a.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and a.question_id = flashcards.question_id). Add tests (anon denied; user without attempt denied; user with attempt allowed) and a mutation that the suite must catch. Update live_check if it enumerates flashcard policies. Then integrate and post done again; reviewer-opus will re-review the S02 rework.
